findings.observation: pipeline.json SourceConfig.api_key allows a string secret; biblio composition uses pipeline_config.source.api_key as highest credential override; live YAML currently has no secret literals.
findings.method: read pipeline.json SourceConfig; read pipeline_config_provider.py; read registration_biblio.py; search api_key in configs/; validate-configs
findings.expected: Credentials only via api_key_env / typed Settings; schema rejects pipeline.source.api_key.
findings.actual: Schema advertises api_key; validate-configs would accept a string; runtime prefers it over BIOETL_* Settings.
findings.impact: Tracked entity YAML can carry live API keys and bypass named env indirection (ADR-057 / REQ-SECRET-001). No live secret observed.
findings.root_cause: Pydantic SourceConfig still models api_key; generate-pipeline exports it; normalizer does not forbid api_key.
findings.remediation: Remove SourceConfig.api_key; regenerate pipeline.json; fail-closed validate-configs; composition reads settings only. Owner is src/ (outside this SCOPE).
findings.automation: architecture test: pipeline.json SourceConfig must not contain api_key
